# AI · cost control

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-blocks.mjs from scripts/blocks-meta.json. Edit that file, not this one. -->

### Budget caps
- What: A spending limit per user and overall that stops AI calls when it is reached.
- Applies when: the app calls a paid AI model.
- Stage: day-one-if
- Kind: checkable
- Proof: test
- Done when: A usage limit per user, and one overall, stops AI calls when reached and shows a clear message.

### Batch API
- What: Send large AI jobs to run later at a lower price.
- Applies when: large AI jobs can wait for their results.
- Stage: with-users
- Kind: checkable

### Model routing
- What: Send each request to the cheapest AI model that can handle it.
- Applies when: AI costs have become significant.
- Stage: with-users
- Kind: checkable

### Unified interface
- What: One layer in your code that talks to every AI provider the same way.
- Applies when: the app uses more than one AI provider.
- Stage: with-users
- Kind: checkable
